summary: Ukraine launched massive drone strikes on Russian territory targeting Moscow, a Kaluga data center, and the Ukhtinsky oil refinery in Komi, while Russia responded with widespread Geran-5 missile and Shahed drone attacks across western and central Ukraine hitting Ivano-Frankivsk, Dubno, and other cities. Russian air defenses claimed 560 Ukrainian UAVs destroyed overnight. Ukraine struck Russian missile production facilities in Nizhny Novgorod and Tver regions, including the Barmin Launch Complex Research Institute and Redkinsky Plant producing fuel for Kh-55/101 cruise missiles.
key_points: Ukrainian drones attacked Moscow with 10 UAVs destroyed by air defenses per Moscow mayor Sobyanin. (Source: @tass_agency/399630)

Ukrainian strikes hit Russian missile production facilities in Nizhny Novgorod and Tver regions, including Barmin Launch Complex Research Institute and Redkinsky Plant producing fuel for Kh-55/101 missiles. (Source: @UkraineNow/84565)
Ukrainian drones attacked Ukhtinsky oil refinery in Komi Republic (Lukoil), producing gasoline, diesel, fuel oil. (Source: @UkraineNow/84561)
Ukrainian drones struck Yandex data center in Kaluga, disabling several modules; governor reported 9 injured. (Source: @UkraineNow/84562)
Russian Geran-5 missiles struck Ivano-Frankivsk and Dubno (Rivne region), with missiles also targeting Lviv region. (Source: @mon1tor_ua/76515, @mon1tor_ua/76513, @mon1tor_ua/76516)
Russian jet-powered Shahed drones launched from multiple directions (Orel, Donetsk, Gvardeyskoye) penetrated deep into western and central Ukraine. (Source: @mon1tor_ua/76488)
Russian forces struck a dry cargo ship delivering military cargo to Odesa port at sea crossing. (Source: @tass_agency/399635)
Russian "North" grouping captured village of Kiyanitsa in Sumy region. (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/33852)

sections.executive_summary: Ukraine launched massive drone strikes on Russian territory targeting Moscow, a Kaluga data center, and the Ukhtinsky oil refinery in Komi, while Russia responded with widespread Geran-5 missile and Shahed drone attacks across western and central Ukraine hitting Ivano-Frankivsk, Dubno, and other cities. Russian air defenses claimed 560 Ukrainian UAVs destroyed overnight. Ukraine struck Russian missile production facilities in Nizhny Novgorod and Tver regions, including the Barmin Launch Complex Research Institute and Redkinsky Plant producing fuel for Kh-55/101 cruise missiles.

points: Ukrainian drones conducted a large-scale attack on Russian territory overnight, targeting Moscow where 10 UAVs were destroyed by air defenses, a Yandex data center in Kaluga where several modules were disabled and 9 people injured, and the Ukhtinsky oil refinery in Komi Republic (Lukoil) producing gasoline, diesel, and fuel oil. (Source: @tass_agency/399630, @UkraineNow/84562, @UkraineNow/84561)

Ukrainian forces struck Russian missile production infrastructure in Nizhny Novgorod and Tver regions, hitting the Barmin Launch Complex Research Institute, the ICBM Liquidation Center, and the Redkinsky Plant manufacturing fuel components for Kh-55 and Kh-101 cruise missiles, per the Ukrainian General Staff. (Source: @UkraineNow/84565)

Ukrainian air defense engaged multiple waves of Russian drones and missiles across western and central Ukraine, with air raid alerts active in Kyiv from 03:06 to 01:49, 05:53 to 04:09, 08:26 to 07:52, and 09:03 on 10.10.2026, indicating sustained pressure. (Source: @eRadarrua/121604, @eRadarrua/121613, @eRadarrua/121614, @eRadarrua/121626, @eRadarrua/121630, @eRadarrua/121639)
A warehouse of the veteran brand 4BRAVE in Kyiv came under attack, per co-founder Zhenya Galich, highlighting strikes on civilian infrastructure in the capital. (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/33848)

Over half of Ukraine's two million veterans believe the state is not protecting their rights, with 1,900 complaints filed in the first eight months of 2026, nearly matching all of 2024, per Ombudsman Lubinets. (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/33854)

Russian forces launched massive Geran-5 missile and jet-powered Shahed drone strikes across Ukraine from multiple launch sites (Orel, Donetsk, Gvardeyskoye), with missiles hitting Ivano-Frankivsk, Dubno (Rivne region), and approaching Lviv, while Shaheds penetrated to Kyiv, Zhytomyr, Vinnytsia, Khmelnytskyi, Ternopil, Chernihiv, Odesa, and Kirovohrad regions. (Source: @mon1tor_ua/76488, @mon1tor_ua/76515, @mon1tor_ua/76513, @mon1tor_ua/76516, @mon1tor_ua/76509, @mon1tor_ua/76526)
Russian air defenses claimed destruction of 560 Ukrainian UAVs over Russian regions overnight, per the Russian Ministry of Defense. (Source: @tass_agency/399641)
Russian forces struck a dry cargo ship delivering military cargo to Odesa port at the sea crossing, per the Russian Ministry of Defense. (Source: @tass_agency/399635)
Russian "North" grouping troops took control of the village of Kiyanitsa in Sumy region. (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/33852)

DPR defense headquarters called for evacuation of residents from Kramatorsk, Sloviansk, Dobropillia, and Druzhkivka to Donetsk, with a special relocation program announced by Pushilin. (Source: @tass_agency/399637, @tass_agency/399639)

Russian forces under guise of "evacuation" forcibly removed 25 civilians from occupied Kharkiv region; their whereabouts and conditions remain unknown, per Ombudsman Lubinets. (Source: @UkraineNow/84570)
Russian drone strike yesterday hit a children's playground in Kyiv region; a man narrowly escaped, per video evidence. (Source: @UkraineNow/84568)

DPR defense headquarters urged evacuation of Kramatorsk, Sloviansk, Dobropillia, and Druzhkivka residents to Donetsk, with housing to be arranged upon arrival, per Pushilin's special relocation program. (Source: @tass_agency/399637, @tass_agency/399639)
Russian "North" grouping captured the village of Kiyanitsa in Sumy region, indicating continued pressure on Ukraine's northeastern border. (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/33852)
Russian forces struck a dry cargo ship delivering military cargo to Odesa port at sea crossing, per Russian MoD. (Source: @tass_agency/399635)

Russian jet-powered Shahed drones were observed in the Black Sea heading toward Odesa region, and along the Odesa-Mykolaiv border heading toward Kirovohrad region. (Source: @kpszsu/84683, @mon1tor_ua/76526)
Two regular Shahed drones targeted Dnipro/Kamianske and one targeted Pavlohrad in Dnipropetrovsk region. (Source: @mon1tor_ua/76491)

Russian Geran-5 missile launched from Bryansk region toward Chernihiv region (Chernihiv district), while multiple jet-powered Shaheds entered Chernihiv region from the north heading toward Kyiv region (Vyshhorod district, Slavutych). (Source: @mon1tor_ua/76509, @eRadarrua/121615, @eRadarrua/121625)
Reconnaissance drones active over Chernihiv, Dnipropetrovsk, and Kirovohrad regions heading toward Kyiv region. (Source: @eRadarrua/121625)
Jet-powered UAVs detected west of Chernihiv region heading toward Kyiv region, and north of Kyiv region heading toward Zhytomyr region. (Source: @kpszsu/84672, @kpszsu/84681, @kpszsu/84671)
Russian drone struck near Velyka Dymerka (Kyiv region) and at Petrivtsi/reservoir and Boryspil. (Source: @eRadarrua/121600, @eRadarrua/121621)
Geran-5 missile from Chernihiv region headed toward Kyiv region (Vyshhorod district), and another from Kyiv region headed toward Zhytomyr region (Korosten district). (Source: @mon1tor_ua/76509)
Russian forces struck a dry cargo ship delivering military cargo to Odesa port at sea crossing, per Russian MoD. (Source: @tass_agency/399635)
Jet-powered Shahed drone detected in Black Sea heading toward Odesa region, and another circling over Odesa city. (Source: @kpszsu/84683, @mon1tor_ua/76526)
Two jet-powered Shaheds moving along Odesa-Mykolaiv border heading toward Kirovohrad region. (Source: @mon1tor_ua/76526)
Jet-powered UAV at Dobroslav (Odesa region) approaching from the south. (Source: @kpszsu/84687)
Residents of Aleshki (Kherson region) forced to evacuate due to high Ukrainian drone activity, per evacuated pensioner. (Source: @tass_agency/399632)
Russian forces forcibly removed 25 civilians from occupied Kharkiv region under guise of evacuation; their status unknown. (Source: @UkraineNow/84570)

Massive Russian missile/drone wave: Geran-5 missiles struck Ivano-Frankivsk and Dubno (Rivne), with others targeting Lviv, Ternopil (Chortkiv district), Khmelnytskyi (Kamianets-Podilskyi, Shepetivka, Novoselitsa, Slavuta), Rivne (Zdolbuniv, Rivne district), Zhytomyr (Korosten, Chopovychi), Vinnytsia (Teplik, Chechelnyk, Tulchyn), Chernihiv, and Kyiv regions. (Source: @mon1tor_ua/76515, @mon1tor_ua/76513, @mon1tor_ua/76516, @mon1tor_ua/76509, @eRadarrua/121610, @eRadarrua/121606, @eRadarrua/121616)

Jet-powered Shahed drones launched from Orel, Donetsk, Gvardeyskoye penetrated deep into Ukraine, with multiple sightings across Chernihiv, Kyiv, Zhytomyr, Vinnytsia, Khmelnytskyi, Ternopil, Poltava, Dnipro, Kirovohrad, Odesa regions. (Source: @mon1tor_ua/76488, @kpszsu/84661, @kpszsu/84664, @kpszsu/84666, @kpszsu/84667, @kpszsu/84670, @kpszsu/84672, @kpszsu/84677, @kpszsu/84681, @kpszsu/84685, @kpszsu/84686, @kpszsu/84688, @kpszsu/84689)

Ukrainian drone attack on Moscow: 10 UAVs destroyed by air defenses; presidential squadron planes circled unable to land; 200+ flights delayed, 100 cancelled at Moscow airports. (Source: @tass_agency/399630, @UkraineNow/84571, @UkraineNow/84572)
